names.reason: linux-native solc 0.8.17 emits 24,666 B for this facet (+139 vs the 24,527 B that Darwin-native solc AND hardhat's solc produce from identical source/settings — platform-divergent optimizer codegen, verified via sha256 of metadata-stripped bytecode in CI run diagnostics 2026-06-12). Deployable artifacts come from hardhat (24,527 B, fits). maxSize caps CI regression room; a real growth of this facet past 24,576 deployable bytes will still surface here once linux measurement exceeds the cap. Audit M12 refactor remains the proper fix.
